messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the nanoScan3 manual, in which situations (apart from the regular check) must the protective device and its application be thoroughly checked?

response.text: Secondo il manuale del nanoScan3, in quali situazioni (oltre al controllo regolare) il dispositivo di protezione e la sua applicazione devono essere controllati accuratamente?
